lines.text: But every year the trip got pushed back, and in ten years she'd seen only four.
Here's the fix. Put every park on one page.
Circle the next one now, in the off season.
Pick one easy day hike there, and check the park's page on N P S dot gov for timed entry or reservations.
lines.show: Pick one easy day hike there, and check the park's page on nps.gov ~ ~ ~ ~ for timed entry or reservations.

lines.text: By spring, Mia's summer trip was booked.
Save this while you plan next year.
